p: Represents information about a file or directory in the file explorer
(string) { get; set } = "": Gets or sets the name of the file or directory
(bool) { get; set }: Gets or sets a value indicating whether this is a directory
(bool) { get; set }: Gets or sets a value indicating whether this directory is expanded (for directories only)
(string) { get; set } = "": Gets or sets the full path to the file or directory
